Name: Fish Hatchery
Author: Omegasis
Description:
This mod adds a new item, the fish hatchery, that hatches a fish from fish roe after three days. Any fish roe can be accepted including modded fish roe. This should allow for some helpful functionality such as easier stocking of fish ponds and being able to create smoked fish from fish roe using this machine.

When fish roe is placed into the machine, there is a chance that the resulting fish hatched from the roe will be of a certain quality as follows.
[list]
[*]Normal Quality - 50%
[*]Silver Quality - 25%
[*]Gold Quality - 15%
[*]Iridium Quality - 10%

[/list]
The fish hatchery can be obtained from [spoiler] Willy's shop for 10,000g.[/spoiler]

Downloads.Description: Fixed unintentionally giving players fish hatcheries when loading the game.
